name: unlockit
description: Show which processes hold a locked file or folder (open handles, working directories) and the window each belongs to -- the 'who has this in use?' Windows never answers

dependencies.note: psutil is optional -- without it the working-directory check (processes whose current directory is inside a folder) is skipped and reported as unavailable. Open-file detection uses the Windows Restart Manager via ctypes and needs nothing extra. Sysinternals handle.exe is used only with --handle.
